title: Joel
author: Joel son of Pethuel.
audience: Judah, calling the people to repentance and hope in the day of the Lord.
historicalSetting: Joel uses locust devastation to call for repentance and points to the outpouring of the Spirit.
keyVerse: Joel 2:28 — "I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh."
christFocus: Joel points to Christ through the promise of the Spirit poured out, fulfilled through the exalted Christ and proclaimed in Acts.
outline: Locust plague and call to repent — Joel 1-2
Spirit promise and final judgment — Joel 2-3
